name: Glucose360
reason_parked: Pre-stable (v0.0.2) with 6 stars and no GitHub releases — high abandonment risk despite 2026 peer review in Diabetes Technology & Therapeutics.
notes: Only CGM analysis library with full event-based integration (meals/exercise); 100% event-based metric coverage vs 0–9% in iglu/AGATA/cgmanalysis. Stanford Snyder Lab. GPL-2.0 limits commercial embedding.

name: Trio
reason_parked: Newer iOS AID system with less published clinical outcomes data than Loop. 314 stars vs Loop's 1.7k despite 1.6k forks.
revisit_when: Published clinical outcomes study and 500+ stars
notes: iOS AID system based on OpenAPS oref algorithm; evolved from FreeAPS X / iAPS. Actively developed under Nightscout org (v0.7.0 April 2026). MIT license. Significant community fork activity. Monitor as the iOS alternative to Loop for users wanting oref algorithm.

name: LoopKit
reason_parked: Developer SDK/framework layer rather than end-user app. Last formal release v3.0 December 2019 though actively used as a dependency.
revisit_when: Stable versioned releases and direct clinical relevance beyond being a Loop/Trio dependency
notes: iOS framework providing data models and HealthKit/CoreData integration for building closed-loop AID apps. Underlying SDK for Loop and Trio. 409 stars. Not user-facing — evaluate when it warrants its own catalog presence independent of the apps built on it.
